propositions: The deterministic readiness floor produces identical P1 and P10 blocking findings for three sibling tickets with identical bare-prose descriptions, yet one bug-type ticket received PASS+signed while two task-type siblings received terminal BLOCK.

The bug-tier lightweight review path in plan_review_precheck downgrades all deterministic findings except P4 from det_blocking to det_advisory before LLM evaluation, allowing later LLM PASS to overrule floor P1/P10 blocks despite the floor's documented contract.

Direct floor invocation on the three pre-rewrite descriptions confirms all three trigger P1 and P10 blocks; production precheck divergence is order-independent and attributable to the bug-tier downgrade logic, not parsing or model sampling variance.

At least 15 other signed plan-review attestations in the store carry PASS verdicts despite DET P1 findings indicating missing Acceptance Criteria, violating the invariant that a certified plan has objective acceptance/verification criteria.
